title: Profile the Persona
not_for: A market-wide profile, a fictional composite presented as real, or a buyer map.
input_gate: Use a real representative user's sourced observations and a privacy-safe identifier; do not invent a biography.

persona.goal: Send accurate invoices without losing a billable afternoon

purchasing_criteria.tradeoff: Will accept an extra approval step to prevent wrong invoices

example_note: A persona is a decision anchor, not statistical evidence about the whole market. Revisit it when other qualified users contradict the pattern.
failure_case: Duplicate priority ranks or a fictional assumption presented as an observed participant fail completion.
